out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink to the left of the hot service line in the back of the house, was being used to stored tongs in between uses.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THAT HAND WASHING SINKS CAN NEVER BE USED FOR ANYTHING BESIDES HAND WASHING. PIC REMOVED THE TONGS FROM THE HAND SINK AND PUT THEM IN THE 3 VAT SINK TO GET PROPERLY WASHED, RINSED AND SANITIZED.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Openings Protected from Pest Entry
violations.observation: Openings to the exterior of the building are present along the back exit door in the kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Fill or close holes and other gaps along floors, walls, and ceilings to protect against the entry of insects and rodents. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THAT GAPS IN THE DOOR AND CEILING ARE POTENTIALLY ALLOWING PEST ENTRANCE INTO THE KITCHEN. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THAT DOOR AND DOOR FRAME NEEDS TO BE REPAIRED BY TIME OF NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. Multiple 5 gallon buckets of food and sauces were being stored on the floor in walk-in refrigerator at time of inspection.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THAT ALL FOODS NEED TO BE STORED AT LEAST 6 INHCES OFF THE GROUND AT ALL TIMES. PIC HAD EMPLOYEE BEGIN REARRANGING THE WALK-IN REFRIGERATOR TO ATTEMPT TO GET ALL BUCKETS OFF THE FLOOR. PLEASE MAKE SURE TO HAVE ALL FOODS IN THE WALK-IN REFRIGERATOR AT LEAST 6 INCHES OFF THE GROUND BY TIME OF NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink to the left of the hot service line in BOH, being used to store dirty utensils in between uses.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition

violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. PIC TOLD EHS THAT MAINTENANCE HAD ALREADY BEEN CALLED AND A PIECE TO FIX THE WALK-IN REFRIGERATOR NEEDED TO BE ORDERED. PART SHOULD ARRIVE TOMORROW. PIC WILL SEND EHS A PICTURE OF THE WALK-IN REFRIGERATOR ONCE IT IS FIXED. FACILITY HAS MULTIPLE ADDITIONAL REFRIGERATORS TO STORE FOOD BESIDES THE WALK-IN REFRIGERATOR TO STORE FOOD AND ALL FOODS HAVE BEEN TAKEN OUT OF THE WALK-IN REFRIGERATOR.

violations.corrective_action: FACILITY WILL REACH OUT TO EHS WHEN WATER IS FIXED AND RUNNING AGAIN. WATER IS CURRENTLY BEING WORKED ON.

violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. PIC SAID THE WALK-IN REFRIGERATOR BROKE DOWN DAY PRIOR TO INSPECTION. ALL FOOD WAS PULLED FROM THE WALK-IN REFRIGERATOR ONCE PIC REALIZED IT WAS NOT HOLDING PROPER TEMPERATURE. REPAIR PERSON HAS ALREADY BEEN NOTIFIED AND IS COMING TO REPAIR THE FRIDGE. FACILITY HAS ADEQUATE ROOM FOR FOOD STORAGE AND ARE ABLE TO STAY OPEN AND OPERATE UNTIL WALK-IN REFRIGERATOR IS FIXED. EHS WILL CONDUCT A FOLLOW UP IN ORDER TO MAKE SURE WALK-IN REFRIGERATOR IS WORKING PROPERLY.

violations.title: When to Wash
violations.observation: A food employee failed to wash his or her hands before engaging in food preparation, after touching bare human body parts, after coughing, sneezing, eating, after handling soiled utensils, or after engaging in any activity that could contaminate the hands. Observed employee did not wash hands after touching raw chicken and putting on new gloves
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands OFTEN especially after handling trash, using the restroom, handling raw meats, handling soiled equipment and utensils, BEFORE putting on clean gloves, etc. Proper handwashing frequencies will aid in the reduction of foodborne illness.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: The handwashing sink at kitchen is equipped with separate cold and hot water faucets rather than a mixing valve or combination faucet. Cold water knob broken. No cold water at hand sink. Unable to properly wash hands for 20 seconds
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F through a mixing valve or combination faucet. Maintenance scheduled to come later that day.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: rice on steam table and hot cabinet not 135f. Hot cabinet was set to 120f and steam table was set on low setting.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. CDI. Discarded or reheated

out_items.name: Sewage and waste water properly disposed

violations.title: Sewage Disposal System, Approved
violations.observation: Sewage is being dumped on the ground surface out back behind the restaurant.
violations.corrective_action: Sewage shall be conveyed to the point of disposal through an approved sanitary sewage system or other system including use of sewage transport vehicles, waste retention tanks, pumps, pipes, hoses, and connections that are constructed, maintained, and operated according to Law. CDI will dump in mop sink inside building.
